falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,620 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be broken, as that bottom formation required lower highs and a retest structure; a breakout above pre-crash resistance invalidates the 'bottom' thesis and suggests the pattern was a false analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would contradict the elevated uncertainty and fear conditions that characterized the August 2024 bottom; it signals complacency incompatible with a valid bottom formation and suggests the 'HOLD' signal was premature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.85% and holds there for 2+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would indicate recession panic rather than controlled disinflation, breaking the macro conditions of the August 2024 bottom where yields stabilized in a higher range; this would prove the current 'bottom' is actually a pre-recession trap

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
